'''Joseph Tidd''' (born 1960) is a British physicist and Professor of technology and innovation management at [[Science Policy Research Unit]]. He is the editor of the ''[[International Journal of Innovation Management]]''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Joe Tidd |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=he2j1ugAAAAJ&hl=en |website=scholar.google.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Innovation Portal |url=http://www.innovation-portal.info/about/ |website=www.innovation-portal.info}}</ref>
